title: Train apprentices only under a training contract
what: Train a person as an apprentice or trainee only under a training contract in effect.

sources.title: Training and Workforce Development Act 2013 (Tas)
sources.quote: An employer must not train a person as if that person were a trainee or apprentice unless – (a) the employer has entered into a training contract with that person; and (b) that training contract has effect at the time the training takes place

administration.who: Secretary of the Department administering the Training and Workforce Development Act 2013 (Tas)
